assets.label: 组件视觉参考板
assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: visual reference board for Arena UI, a premium dark fantasy game web component library. Generate a meticulously art-directed 1536x1024 landscape UI component specimen board on nearly black #0e1116. Modular neatly aligned grid with generous spacing, beautifully crafted thin metallic line work, warm gold #f2b632 primary action, cyan #3ec7e0 selection, blue-gray #171c24 surfaces, sharp 2px-radius corners. Top understated typography reads 'ARENA UI' and 'COMPONENT COLLECTION'. Include a top left group of gold, dark outlined secondary, and red outlined danger action buttons labeled 'BATTLE', 'EQUIP', 'DISMANTLE'; three HP red, MP cyan and XP gold progress bars with numerical labels; a tasteful dark character statistics panel; eight fantasy inventory cells with sword, shield, violet ring, red potion, axe, helmet, scroll and cyan crystal; a gold-accented modal with 'READY TO BATTLE?' and two action buttons; a tab navigation strip; a few small status badges and control switches. Flat front-facing interface layout, typography crisp and minimal, no perspective, no device, no desk, no watermarks. This is a visual exploration image, all important labels must look clean and restrained.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game inventory icon atlas. Generate one landscape 1536x1024 image with EXACTLY 4 columns and 2 rows of equal cells, no gutters, every object centered and fully contained with 20% margin in its own cell. Flat opaque uniform background #171c24 across whole sheet. Row1 left to right: elegant silver longsword with gold guard, reinforced silver and dark steel shield with cyan gemstone, delicate gold ring with violet gemstone, small round glass potion flask with red liquid. Row2 left to right: double headed dark iron battle axe, steel hornless knight helmet, rolled aged parchment scroll with gold seal, cluster of glowing cyan crystals. Hand painted 3D fantasy inventory assets, realistic metal highlights, sculptural depth, coherent top-left lighting and consistent scale. Rich detail clearly readable at small size. No UI frames, borders, labels, numbers, text, characters, watermarks. Every object isolated inside exactly its own 4-by-2 grid cell. Do not let objects overlap cells.

assets.label: Q版·职业武器图集
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable game equipment inventory icon atlas for a fantasy arena and character-growth mini-program. Charming chibi fantasy game art, big heads and compact two-head-tall bodies for characters, rounded chunky shapes, warm cream background where opaque, cocoa outlines, soft hand-painted toy-like 3D depth, broad clean highlights, matte materials, clear silhouettes. Honey gold for actions and rewards, sky cyan for selection and energy, coral only for health or danger, mint only for healing, lavender only for epic rarity. No gritty dark metal, photorealism, sharp gothic spikes or realistic adult proportions. Create ONE landscape 1536x1024 image with EXACTLY FOUR columns and TWO rows of equal-sized cells, eight independent equipment icon groups total. No gutters or visible grid. Flat opaque uniform warm cream #fff7e7 background across the entire sheet, not transparent. Center one complete icon group in each cell. Every icon, including handles and small local shadows, must fit within the CENTRAL 60 percent of its own cell in both axes, leaving at least 20 percent clear margin on all four sides. Do not cross cell boundaries. Rounded chunky silhouettes with softened points, cocoa #654c3f outlines, matte cream ceramic-like armor, cocoa leather and wood, small honey-gold #ffc857 fittings, broad clean top-left highlights and soft hand-painted toy-like depth. Cyan #60c9e8 is reserved for energy crystals; coral only for health/danger, mint only for healing, lavender only for epic rarity, so omit these latter three colors here. No gritty dark steel, photorealistic metal, gothic spikes, text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks, UI frames, people, scenery, loose sparkles or broad glows. Clear at small mobile inventory sizes. Eight distinct weapon silhouettes, reading left to right. ROW ONE: 1 a compact cocoa-shaft spear with a rounded cream leaf-shaped head and tiny gold collar; 2 a chunky cocoa-wood crossbow with a cream bow limb and small gold fittings, without a loaded projectile; 3 a short curved cream dagger with a cocoa grip and round gold pommel; 4 a stout cocoa-handled mace with a cream rounded flanged head, no sharp spikes. ROW TWO: 5 a compact cocoa magic staff with one sky-cyan energy crystal held in a rounded cream crescent; 6 a short cream-bladed halberd on a cocoa shaft with a small gold collar, broad simple silhouette; 7 a stout cocoa shortbow with cream limb tips and clearly attached bowstring, no arrow; 8 a slim cream rapier with a rounded honey-gold cup guard and cocoa grip. Long weapons are shortened into chibi inventory proportions and may tilt slightly to fit safely. These are equipment icons, not action effects. Do not repeat a broad starter sword or round wooden shield.
